name: exo
description: One engineering process for Claude Code: skills that take turns, and agents and prompts that keep discovery off the main context.

specs.title: Where define-scope stores specs
specs.description: docs: files under docs/specs. issues: GitHub issues. both: a file plus a linked issue. Not sure? Keep docs. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

replies.title: How replies are written
replies.description: tight: no preamble, recap or filler; code, paths, errors and warnings stay whole. standard: full prose. An output style outranks this. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

context.title: Context before a fresh phase
context.description: Thousands of tokens the session's context may reach; past it, the next phase of a skill runs in a helper or hands off. Not sure? Keep 100. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

budget.title: Agent model budget
budget.description: normal: every agent dispatches on the model verify/model-table.json names. lean: an opus agent dispatches on sonnet instead. Not sure? Keep normal. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

ship.title: How ship finishes a run
ship.description: ask: ship puts the question. pr-merge: open a pull request and merge it once checks pass. open-pr: open a pull request and stop. push: push the branch. local: keep the commits on this machine. Not sure? Keep ask. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

workspace.title: Where a code-changing run commits
workspace.description: ask: the run puts the question. branch: a new branch in this checkout. worktree: a new git worktree. current: the branch already checked out. Not sure? Keep ask. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.
